prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single premium square collectible avatar for a whimsical French cookie incremental game, the exclusive final reward at the absolute end of progression.
Primary request: create one original majestic yet irresistibly adorable cosmic cookie pegasus called "Gardien de la dernière miette". This is a SINGLE character portrait, NOT a sprite sheet, NOT a grid, NOT a collage.
Subject: a chibi ivory shortbread pegasus with a rounded equine muzzle, huge shining violet eyes, a warm gentle smile, a rich dark-chocolate forelock swirled with ivory cream, and an elegant champagne-gold astral crown with one brilliant central star. Small creamy feathered wings frame its shoulders. One front hoof cradles a single tiny luminous golden cookie crumb like the last star of the universe. Behind the crown, a restrained interlocking infinity-shaped golden halo marks completion and eternity.
Style/medium: polished premium kawaii 3D storybook game illustration, sculpted pastry materials, softly glazed surfaces, high quality refined lighting, inviting charm.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 image, centered face and upper body occupying most of the canvas, face very large and instantly legible as a 40px circular avatar. Keep crown, halo, wings, muzzle and luminous crumb within a central circular safe zone; generous 12 percent edge padding. Perfect frontal or very slight three-quarter view. One clear strong silhouette. No large objects outside the portrait.
Scene/backdrop: simple deep midnight navy background with a subtle violet celestial glow and a few sparse gold stars, no busy environment.
Color palette: midnight blue, warm ivory, dark chocolate, champagne gold, restrained violet iridescence.
Lighting/mood: celebratory and serene final achievement, warm golden rim light, soft cool sky fill, luminous but not blown out.
Text: none.
Constraints: original design, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no interface, no border or rectangular frame. Avoid a humanoid face, realistic horse proportions, visual clutter, cropped crown or ear tips.
